review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature display part (PROPOSED): a seven-ribbed neck frill with a scalloped fleshy web, folding on a shape key.

textures.name: T_PartFrill_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartFrill_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the fan laid down flat along the body toward the tail

part_rules.handles_note: Both keys are on Frill and FrillWeb with the same names; the runtime sets them together.
part_rules.placement_note: Meant for the neck, just behind the head; the fan leans back toward the tail and folds flat along it.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
